data.subject: Whatnot's Dublin expansion
data.body:
Hi Kristin,

Whatnot opened a new European headquarters in Dublin and plans to double its Irish workforce. Five months into your role as CFO, establishing a European headquarters usually creates additional foreign vendor management and multi-entity close workflows. Instacart cut AP approval time from 2 weeks to 2 days using Zamp to automate finance back-office workflows.

Are you open to a 20-minute call to discuss this?

[Your name]
